about_the_game:
🧭 About AVILON

AVILON is a powerful tool designed for gamers who want to explore, complete, and truly master their favorite worlds.
Built with a modern and customizable interface, AVILON lets you access interactive maps from multiple games and platforms — all in one place.

Plan your routes, locate collectibles, uncover secrets, and optimize your progress without opening a browser or juggling dozens of tabs.
Whether you’re hunting for that final trophy on PlayStation, completing achievements on PC or Xbox, or simply exploring every corner of your favorite games, AVILON provides the most organized, intuitive, and immersive way to do it.

🗺️ Interactive maps

  • Add and manage detailed maps for different games and all your gaming platforms. Choose between an interactive map or an image.

    🎨 Customizable themes

    Choose from a variety of visual styles and customize your AVILON environment.

    💾 Clean interface for long gaming sessions

    Avilon has a clean and intuitive interface, where you always know where each game is.

    📘INTEGRATED GUIDE

    Learn everything you need to know about AVILON from within the program.

    ⭐ MARK YOUR FAVORITE GAMES WITH ONE CLICK AND ALWAYS HAVE THEM AT HAND.

🎮 WHY AVILON?

AVILON isn’t just another utility — it’s your gamer control center.
Bring together all your maps and exploration tools in one convenient hub, keep track of your progress, and explore smarter.
No more relying on scattered web pages or losing time searching for information: everything you need is here, in AVILON.

🚀 IN CONSTANT EVOLUTION

The project is constantly evolving to ensure proper use and to add new features. Keep in mind that AVILON is being developed by a single person, so bugs or errors may be more visible. Nevertheless, I share the roadmap we hope to continue. Your support is very important for the future of AVILON.
